title: trqp: mypy --strict [index] error in error_document
description: git-vouch-trqp:311-313. payload is annotated dict[str, object], so 'payload["inResponseTo"]["id"] = ...' indexes an object; mypy --strict reports 'Unsupported target for indexed assignment ("object") [index]'. It works at runtime, but the annotation is wrong about the value, and the line is the only real type error in the bridge (the other mypy hit, line 372 [str-bytes-safe], is a typeshed artifact of server_address possibly being bytes for AF_UNIX). What goes wrong: a type-checked refactor of the error path gets no help here, and anyone adding mypy to the gate meets a spurious failure. Fix: build the dict first: 'in_response: dict[str, str] = {"typeUri": request["type"]}; if ...: in_response["id"] = request["id"]; payload["inResponseTo"] = in_response'.
